sleeping_bag.name: Standard Dragonfly 400 Down Sleeping Bag (-5C)
sleeping_bag.subtitle: current official Standard Dragonfly 400, normalized to standard size
sleeping_bag.fill_material: ALLIED Feather + Down HyperDRY goose down
sleeping_bag.shell_fabric: Pertex Quantum recycled nylon with Y Fuse technology
sleeping_bag.key_features: Standard row normalized from the current official AU listing; 731 g total from the standard product-card result; 400 g of 800 loft HyperDRY goose down; box baffles; one-third zip; ISO 23537-1 tested; includes compression stuff sack and mesh storage bag.
sleeping_bag.marketing_summary: Macpac positions the Dragonfly 400 as a lightweight 3-season down bag with practical comfort and durability features for tent and hut use rather than extreme minimalist racing cuts.
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Everything you need for quick and easy getaways, with Y Fuse durability, box baffles, adjustable hood and responsible materials.
sleeping_bag.use_cases: Tent camping, hut trips and lightweight backpacking across most three-season conditions.
sleeping_bag.source_notes: Verified 2026-05-17. Current official AU page and category listing were used. The standard-size category result exposed A$699.99 regular and A$524.99 member/sale pricing plus the standard target weight aligning with the user list. No verified FR retailer price found.
sleeping_bag.comparison_notes: Macpac is AU/NZ market-facing. Structured EUR/FR price remains null because no verified French seller page was captured.
sleeping_bag.care_instructions: Store in mesh bag for long-term loft; wash only when necessary; use specialized down wash; dry carefully and avoid prolonged direct sunlight.
sleeping_bag.compatible_accessories: compression stuff sack; mesh storage bag
sleeping_bag.warranty_notes: Macpac site promotes warranty and repairs support; exact term not captured from the product page.
sleeping_bag.official_price_text: Official AU page showed A$699.99 regular price and A$524.99 member/clearance price.
